senses.gloss: m. (גּוּס II) troop, esp. ravaging troop, invaders, robbers (= b. h. גְּדוּד).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:7">Pes. III, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 49a:4">49ᵃ</cite>) (if one left his home) <he>להציל מן הג׳</he> Y. ed. a. Ms. M. (ed. <he>עכום</he>, <he>גויים</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) to rescue (Israelites &c.) from an invading troop.
<cite ref="Yevamot 122b:5">Yeb. 122ᵇ</cite> <he>רדף אחרינו ג׳</he> a band pursued us; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גַּיָּיסוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:7">Ib. XVI, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Yevamot 122a:11">122ᵃ</cite>) the country is <he>משובשת בג׳</he> in confusion on account of invaders.
Ruth R. to I, 5; a. fr.—Denom. גִּיֵּיס to arrange battle, to orderout troops; to array.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:10">Ib.</cite> <he>כמה גייסות … לגַיֵּיס</he> how many troops can I send out.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:10">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> <he>התחיל מְגַיֵּיס חיילותיו וכ׳</he> he began to arrange his armies for battle; a. fr. [<cite ref="C00663"><he>גייס</he></cite> pr. n. m., v. <cite ref="C00663"><he>גַּיּוּס</he></cite>.]
